verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.
“These two things, mendicants, are not mortifying.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco katakalyāṇo hoti, katakusalo, katabhīruttāṇo, akatapāpo, akataluddo, akatakibbiso.
verses.english: It’s when someone has done good and skillful things that keep them safe, but has not done bad things, violence and sin.

verses.pali: So ‘kataṁ me kalyāṇan’tipi na tappati, ‘akataṁ me pāpan’tipi na tappati.
verses.english: Thinking, ‘I have done good things’, they’re not mortified. Thinking, ‘I haven’t done bad things’, they’re not mortified.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā atapanīyā”ti.
verses.english: These are the two things that are not mortifying.”
when their body breaks up, that wise person

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
